claims.text: The resort sits on a secluded barrier island.

findings.quote: Located on a secluded barrier Island, this Amelia Island beach resort marries coastal luxuries with authentic charm.

claims.text: Every guestroom and suite has a private balcony and ocean views.

findings.quote: Each of our luxury accommodations in Amelia Island features a private balcony and ocean views
findings.note: Each accommodation has balcony and ocean views

claims.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a fireplace in the living area and a formal dining area seating six.

findings.quote: the one-bedroom suite features a generous living area with a cozy fireplace and a formal dining area with seating for six

claims.text: Three private boardwalks lead guests to the oceanfront, buffered by sand dunes and sea oats.

findings.quote: Three private boardwalks provide guest access to a quarter mile of pristine oceanfront, buffered by a natural landscape of sand dunes and sea oats.

claims.text: The Golf Club of Amelia Island has an 18-hole course designed by Mark McCumber and Gene Littler.

findings.quote: The Golf Club of Amelia Island was designed by PGA Tour veterans Mark McCumber and Gene Littler.
18-hole championship golf course designed by PGA Tour veteran Mark McCumber and golf legend Gene Littler

claims.text: Coquina serves Latin cuisine focused on seafood and coastal dishes inspired by the island's Eight Flags heritage.

findings.quote: Coquina is an innovative, new Amelia Island Latin restaurant with cuisine focused on seafood and coastal dishes inspired by the island’s Eight Flags heritage.

claims.text: Tidewater Grill is a casual restaurant serving lunch, dinner and drinks.

findings.quote: Tidewater Grill has an instantly familiar, casual atmosphere for lunch, dinner, and drinks.

claims.text: The resort partners with tennis coach Patrick Mouratoglou for training camps, private lessons and retreats.

findings.quote: The exclusive tennis center offers a variety of training camps, private lessons, and retreats to deliver a premium tennis experience for everyone.
The Ritz-Carlton, Amelia Island is pleased to partner with the world-renowned tennis coach, Patrick Mouratoglou, for the first signature tennis center in Northeast Florida.

claims.text: Guests can join the resort marine biologist to locate, track and record dolphin behavior for a research study on the Amelia River and Cumberland Sound.

findings.quote: Guests join Resort Marine Biologist, Nick Williams, for a one-of-a- kind adventure to locate, track and record dolphin behavior for an on-going research study on the Amelia River and Cumberland Sound.

claims.text: In the Hook, Line & Supper experience, guests fish with the Executive Chef on the Amelia River.

findings.quote: Guests fish with Executive Chef along the scenic Amelia River on the west side of Amelia Island.

claims.text: Beach horseback riding along the Atlantic shore is available, and Amelia Island is one of the few places where it is permitted.

findings.quote: Enjoy a serene horseback ride along the shores of the Atlantic. Amelia Island is one of the few places where beach horseback riding is permitted.

claims.text: The Nature Center has three on-site Naturalists specializing in marine science and biology.

findings.quote: With three on-site professional Naturalists specializing in Marine Science and Biology, the Nature Center offers enriching activities for everyone.

claims.text: Enhancement work is scheduled from October 2026 into early 2027, including select public restrooms, the function space and the main pool; guests keep access to one of the resort's two pools throughout.

findings.quote: From October 2026 through January 2027, select public restrooms will undergo enhancements
From November 16, 2026 – January 2027, the resort's Legacy Function Space will enter its next chapter of transformation
As enhancements take place at the main pool, guests will continue to always enjoy access to one of the resort’s two pools throughout the project.
findings.note: Main pool and one of two pools access

claims.text: The hotel does not have an airport shuttle to Fernandina Beach Municipal Airport.

findings.quote: No, The Ritz-Carlton, Amelia Island does not have an airport shuttle to Fernandina Beach Municipal Airport.

claims.text: The resort is exclusively cashless; guests present a credit card at check-in.

findings.quote: The Ritz-Carlton, Amelia Island is an exclusively cashless resort. Guests must present a credit card at check-in
